newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end slightly firm, but seen soft.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end slightly firm, but seen soft.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares traded slightly firmer on Thursday, but brokers said the market's short-term outlook remained soft as many investors were inactive, still awaiting the outcome of some new issues later this month.
"We had a one-off, the odd shift upwards today on the basis of a few select big counters," one broker said of the main industrial index's 5.95- point rise to 10,076.89.

The index was helped up by a 20-cent gain to 1,720 in conglomerate Delta, banking group Barclays, which traded 100 cents higher at 3,400, and tobacco company Rothmans, which jumped 300 cents to 4,300.

The secondary seven-share mining index remained stable on Thursday at 969.89, anchored by two local gold giants Ashanti, which traded unchanged at 9,500, and Rio Tinto which was also unchanged at 2,500.
